'''Scouter''' is an old pack horse.

==Appearance==
Scouter is shaggy-maned.

==Activities==
Scouter is led, overloaded, by [[Bulen]] to find [[Lan Mandragoran]] on the [[Warder]]'s trek across the [[Borderlands]].{{ref/book|13|p}} They travel through [[Kandor]] and [[Arafel]], acquiring other horses to carry both people and supplies.{{ref/book|13|7}}{{ref/book|13|23}}
